ratings_why.fun: Line order becomes a real puzzle every round, and the fallen feeding the front is satisfying to watch grow.
ratings_why.distinct: The Lead as a moving title is fresh, though under it sit familiar deathrattle buffs and token floods.

verdict_why: Lemenår Herald's boom-and-crash wording needs a fix before it can be read; the rest reads cleanly.

points.text: Lemenår Herald doesn't say what halves: the whole stored Pup bonus or one turn's gain, and whether two Heralds share one bonus. Write it as a named herd total, like a tribe bonus, that the card adds to and a loss halves.
Onward and Takes the lead carry the fantasy: a player sees the fallen hand their strength to the front. Keep these two words as the tribe's whole vocabulary.

The Front Lemming makes the lead hop every attack, so it is the hardest card to follow. A one-line reminder on the card, such as 'the banner moves after each attack', would help the eye follow the banner.
Tent-Striker is a plain buff with no Lead hook. Striking camp could move the herd instead: for example, your Lead gains the buff and passes it back down the line.
Herding Councillor rewards bunching Lemmings next to the Lead, which reads well. It could also say 'onward' in some way, such as also buffing the next Lead.

standouts.why: Cliff-Singer is the doom cult as a mechanic: kill the front, and the next one inherits everything. Instantly readable and on theme.
Gerd the Shouter puffs up against the biggest enemy: tiny folk picking fights with giants, told in one line.
Brother Onward turns every death's gift into lasting legend, a clear build-defining Tier 5.

weakest.why: Tent-Striker is a generic Start of Turn tribe buff with no Lead or Onward hook.
Old Mother Lemen is a familiar 'when a friendly dies, others gain' capstone, with nothing about lineage or the front.
Herding Councillor is a plain end-of-turn buffer, readable but forgettable.

flags.note: What halves on a loss, and how several Heralds stack, can't be read from the text.
A Lead that moves after every attack is hard to follow without a strong on-screen banner.
Golden Midwife with Old Mother Lemen and Owl-Scold Chorus stacks many death payoffs in one fight.
Weeks-Old Breeder feeding Tally pays gold every turn; worth the owner's eye on economy.
